svg.title: September 2026 Arctic sea-ice extent
svg.desc: Accurate polar map from NSIDC Sea Ice Index monthly extent polygons and Natural Earth coastlines. White shows September monthly sea-ice extent; NASA Blue Marble shows land colours and topography (September 2004 composite). This is a monthly map, not the 12 September daily minimum. Coordinates use NSIDC polar stereographic north, EPSG 3411.
svg.metadata: Land imagery: NASA Earth Observatory / Reto Stöckli (NASA/GSFC), Blue Marble Next Generation, September 2004. Reprojected to EPSG:3411 and clipped to Natural Earth land; separate NSIDC September 2026 extent overlay.
